_doc: Extra arm poses read by autoencoder/auto_en_new.py at startup (--pose-config). Ticks: 4096 per revolution. The 4 cycle poses (up/right/down/left) stay in auto_en_new.py; this file only ADDS poses. rest = the arm folded on its cradle (measured 2026-10-24). rest_sequence / wake_sequence are done in order, one step at a time; a step moves only the joints it lists. VERIFY every step once by hand at low speed before trusting it. 2026-10-25: J2 moves FIRST and alone (the old order coiled J3/J4 with J2 still at home and hit the frame); wake is the exact reverse. 2026-10-25 18:25: taught by hand with rest_teach.py from the STANDBY pose; step 'start' (added 18:3x) drives there first so every rest repeats the taught path from wherever the arm is. wake ends on that pose, then autoen goes home. 2026-10-25 18:4x: rest J3/J4/J5 set to the positions they REACHED in base_20261025_183009 (3041/956/335; targets 3059/929/303 left them pushing: rest hold 0.287 W vs home 0.118 W). 2026-10-25 18:5x: torque_off_joints = J2, J3 only (operator: the frame carries the arm there); J1, J4-J6 stay powered. Then J5 (wrist roll) added on the operator's request: torque_off_joints = J2, J3, J5.
